title: Flat Spend Category taxonomy matches the `budget-position-v1` result
steps: Build a Budget Plan Revision whose Spend Categories are all root nodes with no descendants. Supply Budget Actuals across budgeted, Zero Budget, omitted, and uncategorized states. Calculate the Budget Position under `budget-position-v2`.
expected: Every bucket assignment, category ordering, row actual, direct actual, planned value, variance, and total is identical to the `budget-position-v1` result for the same inputs, and every descendant actual is exactly zero with empty absorbed identifiers.
